# llm-cpp

`llm_stream.hpp` from [llm-cpp](https://github.com/Mattbusel/llm-cpp) v1.4.0
(`include/llm/llm_stream.hpp`), MIT licensed (see `LICENSE`), copied unmodified.

Flock uses only its SSE parser (`llm::parse_sse`), included with
`LLM_STREAM_NO_CURL` so the header pulls in nothing beyond the C++ standard library.

To update, copy `include/llm/llm_stream.hpp` from a newer llm-cpp release over this file.
